plugins.name: goodfellow
plugins.description: Named after the inventor of adversarial networks. Your good fellow for shipping code — adversarial review, knowledge compounding, follow-up tracking.

skills.name: brainstorm
skills.description: Design exploration with knowledge compounding — reads accumulated principles before proposing approaches, writes spec, auto-dispatches spec-review. Accepts --from-loop N to seed from a tracked follow-up.
headings: principle INDEX (P-NNN id + title + one-line rule), NOT the full bodies. The full
corpus is ~17k tokens / ~300 directives — well past the accuracy-erosion ceiling.
All error handling stays in Python (bad config / missing core / unreadable file ->
non-zero exit + stderr); a non-zero exit means a config/packaging problem — stop.
skills.description_zh: 在提出设计方案前读取积累的原则，进行设计探索、撰写规格并自动分派规格审查，可用 --from-loop N 从已跟踪后续事项起步。

skills.name: branch
skills.description: Create an isolated git worktree for feature work — clean separation between feature development and main branch.
skills.description_zh: 为功能开发创建隔离 Git 工作树，分离功能工作与主分支。

skills.name: close
skills.description: Structured session closing — commit check, persist learnings to knowledge file, promote pending entries, check loop staleness, branch cleanup.
headings: Fail CLOSED: a dedup error (drift / unparseable principles) must STOP, not silently
persist a restatement. principles.md is required; the web supplement is optional.
if $PID is non-empty: skip persisting, log "skipped (restates $PID)"
Valid as written — substitute your own values. --name is a kebab-slug matching
[a-z0-9-]; --type is one of principle|pattern|gotcha; --domain is optional (omit if none):
skills.description_zh: 结构化结束会话，检查提交、保存经验到知识文件、提升待处理条目、检查后续事项陈旧程度并清理分支。

skills.name: codex-review
skills.description: Direct Codex adversarial review on the current diff, a specific file, or a commit. Two-stage generator+judge pipeline; falls back to a single Claude reviewer when Codex is unavailable.
headings: Why Codex as the adversarial reviewer
skills.description_zh: 通过 Codex 对当前差异、指定文件或提交进行对抗审查，采用生成者和判断者两阶段；Codex 不可用时回退单个 Claude 审查者。

skills.name: execute
skills.description: Per-task plan implementation with built-in verification (lint, format, tests) after each task, knowledge gotcha checking, and optional phase-boundary Codex review. Autopilot mode runs all tasks without pausing.
headings: principle INDEX (P-NNN id + title + one-line rule), NOT the full bodies. The full
corpus is ~17k tokens / ~300 directives — well past the accuracy-erosion ceiling.
All error handling stays in Python (bad config / missing core / unreadable file ->
non-zero exit + stderr); a non-zero exit means a config/packaging problem — stop.
2.0. Optional: parallel implementers, worktree-isolated (opt-in, per phase)
CKPT = the Step-3 checkpoint SHA; SLUG = task id, e.g. t-2-3
On success $OUT is the review-artifact path (Codex path is judged; see its
`## Judge audit` section). Reject the REVIEW_FAILED sentinel before reading.
skills.description_zh: 逐项实施计划，每项后验证代码检查、格式与测试，核对知识中的易错点，并可在阶段边界进行 Codex 审查；自动驾驶模式连续执行所有任务。

skills.name: grill
skills.description: Opt-in relentless one-question-at-a-time interview for underspecified or high-stakes design intent. Fires ONLY on explicit invocation — /goodfellow:grill, "grill me on X", "interview me about X", "grill me". Does NOT claim the generic "design X" / "brainstorm X" triggers (those stay with brainstorm). Scouts facts, interviews to a ledger-empty finish, writes a spec, auto-dispatches spec-review.
headings: 3a. Build the complete spec, then publish atomically
Guard: enforce strict kebab-case BEFORE the slug is interpolated into any path (mktemp /
target below). Sanitize first, then halt if it still isn't valid — never let a topic-derived
slug carrying "/", "..", or other path chars escape docs/specs/ (path traversal).
1. Author the COMPLETE spec (frontmatter + body) into a temp file in the SAME dir.
3. Publish with atomic exclusive-create. ln() fails atomically if the target already
exists, so two concurrent grills with the same date+slug cannot both win the path.
--- pending-review recovery (written UP FRONT, cleared only on confirmed successful review) ---
skills.description_zh: 仅明确调用时对资料不足或高风险设计意图进行逐题深入访谈，先调查事实、直到问题清单清空，再写规格并分派审查；普通设计或头脑风暴使用 brainstorm。

skills.name: plan-review
skills.description: Adversarial plan review with research injection — verifies factual claims via web search, then runs multi-round review with verifier pass. Research-then-adversarial grounds critics in verified facts.
headings: principle INDEX (P-NNN id + title + one-line rule), NOT the full bodies. The full
corpus is ~17k tokens / ~300 directives — well past the accuracy-erosion ceiling.
All error handling stays in Python (bad config / missing core / unreadable file ->
non-zero exit + stderr); a non-zero exit means a config/packaging problem — stop.
skills.description_zh: 先联网验证计划事实主张，再开展多轮对抗评审和核验，让评审依据已证实事实。

skills.name: plan
skills.description: Write an implementation plan from a spec — exhaustive task decomposition with dependency graph, acceptance criteria, and spec-coverage verification. Auto-dispatches plan-review.
headings: principle INDEX (P-NNN id + title + one-line rule), NOT the full bodies. The full
corpus is ~17k tokens / ~300 directives — well past the accuracy-erosion ceiling.
All error handling stays in Python (bad config / missing core / unreadable file ->
non-zero exit + stderr); a non-zero exit means a config/packaging problem — stop.
skills.description_zh: 根据规格生成含完整任务拆分、依赖图、验收标准与规格覆盖验证的实施计划，并自动分派计划审查。

skills.name: prune-stale
skills.description: Sweep merged/stale branches, orphan worktrees, and old JSONL logs. Configurable retention via GOODFELLOW_TRIAGE_RETENTION_DAYS and GOODFELLOW_RUNS_RETENTION_DAYS.
skills.description_zh: 清理已合并或陈旧分支、孤立工作树与旧 JSONL 日志，通过指定环境参数配置保留期。

skills.name: public-pr
skills.description: Pre-open gate + cross-fork mechanics for opening a PR to a PUBLIC or not-solely-owned repo (a fork → upstream, an OSS contribution, any world-visible repo). Runs a user-configurable internal-ref scrub, a contributor checklist, and the correct cross-fork `gh pr create`. Not for your own private-workflow PRs — use `ship` for those.
headings: exit 0 = clean · exit 1 = hits (BLOCK) · exit 2 = --require-denylist with none set
Step 2 — Ship only the mergeable unit
Step 3 — Description must match shipped behavior
Step 4 — Self-verify at the maintainer's bar
skills.description_zh: 在向公开或非独有仓库创建 PR 前检查内部引用脱敏和贡献清单，并处理 fork 到上游的 gh pr create；私有工作流 PR 使用 ship。

skills.name: ship
skills.description: Verify, review, create PR, extract learnings to knowledge file, file follow-up loops. --quick: single-round review for small diffs. Safety-critical findings block PR creation.
headings: On success $OUT is the review-artifact path; the Codex path is judged (see its
`## Judge audit` section). Reject the REVIEW_FAILED sentinel before reading —
never treat a failed review as an empty (zero-findings) pass.
Fail CLOSED: a dedup error (drift / unparseable principles) must STOP, not silently
persist a restatement. principles.md is required; the web supplement is optional.
Valid as written — substitute your own values. --name is a kebab-slug matching

skills.description_zh: 验证和审查改动、创建 PR、把经验保存到知识文件并记录后续事项；--quick 用于小差异单轮审查，安全关键发现阻止 PR 创建。

skills.name: snap-compact
skills.description: Extract learnings from the session before context compaction — preserves knowledge that would otherwise be lost when the context window is compressed.

5. After the boundary — assert the guard set is intact
skills.description_zh: 在上下文压缩前提取会话经验，保存可能因压缩丢失的知识。

skills.name: spec-review
skills.description: Multi-round adversarial spec review with research injection, verifier pass, and knowledge-file principle checking. Dispatches two reviewers per round (Claude + Codex, or single Claude fallback).
headings: principle INDEX (P-NNN id + title + one-line rule), NOT the full bodies. The full
corpus is ~17k tokens / ~300 directives — well past the accuracy-erosion ceiling.
All error handling stays in Python (bad config / missing core / unreadable file ->
non-zero exit + stderr); a non-zero exit means a config/packaging problem — stop.
1. Each round, dispatch both reviewers in parallel
1.5 Research injection (between round 1 and round 2 only)
skills.description_zh: 结合研究、核验和知识原则进行多轮对抗规格审查，每轮分派 Claude 与 Codex 两名审查者，不可用时回退单个 Claude。

skills.name: triage
skills.description: Two-reviewer loop triage — independently assess each open loop, reconcile verdicts, batch operator confirmation. 3-cycle hard cap on unclear findings. Ground truth logged to triage-log.jsonl.
headings: Reviewer 1 (Claude subagent) — one per loop, dispatched concurrently
Reviewer 2 (Codex bridge or Claude fallback) — one per loop
| Title | Reviewer 1 | Reviewer 2 | Reconciled | Confidence | Action
skills.description_zh: 由两名审查者独立评估开放后续事项、协调结论并批量请求操作者确认，模糊发现最多三轮，事实记录到 triage-log.jsonl。

headings: brainstorm -> spec-review -> plan -> plan-review -> execute -> ship
Rounds 1-3 are gateless; round 4+ asks once. Knowledge compounds across runs.
List open loops (inside Claude Code — CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is set automatically)
Seed a brainstorm from a loop
Full auto — chain runs hands-off with strategic halts
Dry run first — logs decisions without mutating project code
(the decision log itself IS written to .goodfellow/runs/ — that's the audit trail)
